name: personal-shopper
description: Compare products and services, research contractor qualifications and project costs, and build package-aware grocery lists with saved shopping context.

interface.shortDescription: Compare products, services, project costs and groceries
interface.longDescription: Compare products, services, and contractors against user needs, scope, qualifications, fit, and current evidence. Research applicable official permit fees and project costs, using comparable completed outcomes for reference-class forecasts when supported. Preserve scoped shopping records and the full approved meal-plan grocery workflow.
defaultPrompt: Compare products and relevant alternatives that fit my needs and existing equipment.
Continue Meal Planner's approved grocery-handoff/v1 packet to build a priced grocery list.
Compare service or contractor offers on scope, qualifications, exclusions, and fees.
Research official permit costs and evidence-based project forecasts.
Review or update my scoped shopping preferences.
